description: Newest token launches on Base (Uniswap, Aerodrome, Bankr, launchpads), up to 20, each risk-checked at request time: Sourcify verification, upgradeable proxy, owner type, mint/pause/blacklist/fee functions, and a flag for copycats of major tokens (USDC, ETH, BTC...) that aren't the real contract. B20 native tokens are labeled as not checkable by bytecode. Plus pool DEX, age, liquidity, FDV and 1h buys/sells. Data: GeckoTerminal. Heuristics, not an audit. Costs $0.01.
name: base_launch_feed
